description: This file contains a report module for generating IRS 1099 forms within the ERPNext system, including data retrieval, PDF generation, and address formatting functions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Retrieves IRS 1099 data based on filters, returning columns and data for the report.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the IRS 1099 report.

methods.name: irs_1099_print
methods.description: Generates and downloads the IRS 1099 PDF forms based on filters.

methods.name: get_payer_address_html
methods.description: Fetches the company's address in HTML format for the IRS form.

methods.name: get_street_address_html
methods.description: Fetches the supplier's address in HTML format for the IRS form.
